Short title and commencement

ACT XVI OF 1994
ACT XVI OF 1994
AIRPORTS SECURITY FORCE (AMENDMENT) ACT, 1994
An Act further to amend the Airports Security Force Act, 1975
[Gazette of Pakistan, Extraordinary, Part I, 7th August, 1994]
The following Act of
Majlis-e-Shoora (Parliament) received the assent of the President on the 3rd
August, 1994 and are hereby published for general information:
1. Short title and commencement.--(1) This Act may be called the
Airports Security Force (Amendment) Act, 1994.
(2) It shall come into force at
once.

Amendment of section 7A, Act LXXVII of 1975

ACT XVI OF 1994
ACT XVI OF 1994
AIRPORTS SECURITY FORCE (AMENDMENT) ACT, 1994
An Act further to amend the Airports Security Force Act, 1975
[Gazette of Pakistan, Extraordinary, Part I, 7th August, 1994]
The following Act of
Majlis-e-Shoora (Parliament) received the assent of the President on the 3rd
August, 1994 and are hereby published for general information:
2. Amendment of section 7A, Act LXXVII of 1975.--In the Airports
Security Force Act, 1975 (LXXVII of 1975), in section 7A, after subsection (3),
the following new subsection shall be added, namely:--
"(4)
Notwithstanding anything contained in any other law for the time being in
force, except the authorities specified in subsections (1) and (2) of section
7F, no other authority, tribunal or Court shall have jurisdiction to vary,
modify, alter, annul, set aside, revise or review any order passed by any
officer of the Fore, authorised under the Pakistan Army Act, 1952 (XXXIX of
1952).".
